summary.text: Deborah Stiles is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 85, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A farmer in Tucker County, she previously worked as an agricultural and rural policy researcher and educator.

paragraphs.text: Deborah Stiles was born in Elkins, West Virginia, and earned a bachelor's degree from Marshall University and graduate degrees from the University of Maine in 1990 and 1997.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said her father worked as a county agricultural agent and farmed part-time, and that she grew up in 4-H and FFA.

She said she worked as a rural studies and humanities professor at an agricultural college and as a rural and agricultural policy researcher before retiring in 2020, and that she returned to her family farm in Tucker County in 2021.
Stiles said in that survey that she decided to run for West Virginia Commissioner of Agriculture because of the challenges she saw facing farmers.
Ballotpedia lists her as affiliated with the Friends of Mountaintop Public Library and the Five Rivers Public Library.
